column1: # competitor_acc is hiphase's SEPARATED fraction: of the reads in the window that
# truth can score, the share one hiphase block places correctly. Same definition
# as min_separated in the expectations, so the two are directly comparable and
# the difference is the headroom. 'none_spanning' = no hiphase block spans it.
# 3,852,321: hiphase spans it in one 875 kb block at 63.1% read purity -- a wrong
# join, so its 0.543 is not a target to match.
# Windows were selected as gaps we leave open where reads are separable; the
# truth-het chain test is what established separability, not a goal in itself.
# Larger noncentromeric gaps: HiPhase 1.6.0 on the same pgphase VCF and BAM.
# Exact boundary keys share one HiPhase PS; local purity >=98%, both 10-kb flanks >=95%.
# Each window (50-kb flank on each side) has identical variant keys in the current and HiPhase input VCFs.
# The corresponding pgphase isolated replay remains split; see the 2026-09-24 large-gap manifest.
